title: Dataq Sentinel — Overview
meta_description: Security architecture you can evidence — for humans, machines and models.

blocks.x: The Dataq Software build of Dataq Sentinel — Overview: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

Dataq Sentinel unifies our security delivery: zero-trust enforcement points (identity, posture, segmentation, workload identity), detection-as-code with ATT&CK coverage, cloud posture guardrails, and the AI-specific layer — prompt-injection defense, agent containment, shadow-AI discovery and model security cards.

blocks.title: Dataq Sentinel — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: The engineering bet is explicit: models, agents and rules move through versioned, evaluated releases across the enterprise, which is what makes the reported delta defensible in audit.

blocks.x: The design principle here is simple: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy across the enterprise, so a regression is a cohort, never an estate.

Sentinel is engineered for the evidence economy: controls mapped across SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-207, DORA and AI regimes, tested continuously, exported to auditors. Boards get measured trust reduction, not adjectives.

At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy in Dataq Sentinel, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.
The design principle here is simple: every state change is replayable from the signed baseline in Dataq Sentinel, so drift shows up as a ticket with an owner, not as a mystery.

The part that survives audit is the boring part: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default across the Dataq Sentinel estate, which is what makes the reported delta defensible in audit.
